source: OpenStreetMap — landuse=cemetery and amenity=grave_yard, via Overpass, clipped to this map's record regions.
licenceNote: Share-alike, and in its own file for that reason, exactly like data/archives-osm.json. Everything else here is CC0 and must stay so.
note: UNCHECKED. Named cemeteries only — Overpass returned 24,996 in the region bounding boxes and most carry no name at all, which makes them a shape on a map rather than a place a researcher can ask about. Clipped to the rings, not the boxes.
